content.text: Section 18 meets the preferred position in full, so no redline is needed.

input.quote: 18.1 Vendor shall maintain, at its own expense throughout the term and for one year afterward, commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, employer's liability of USD 1,000,000, professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability insurance of USD 5,000,000.
input.rationale: Section 18 contains a full vendor insurance clause that meets our preferred position: CGL of USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, professional (E&O) liability of USD 2M, and cyber/privacy liability of USD 5M (appropriate since Vendor hosts Customer Data), maintained at Vendor's expense for the term plus one year. Section 18.2 adds certificates of insurance and evidence of coverage on request, reputable insurers, primary coverage where customary, advance notice of cancellation or material reduction, and confirmation that insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities. Employer's liability of USD 1M is an addition in our favour. No redline required.
